model.title: Duplication Scoring Act of 2025
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY)

summary.text: The bill would require the Comptroller General to review proposed legislation and identify any ways it might duplicate or overlap with programs, offices, and initiatives already run by the federal government. This analysis aims to help lawmakers avoid creating redundant government functions.
